newsitem.title: UK: Saudi Sept Berri, Arab Heavy to Europe up 15 cts.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Sept Berri, Arab Heavy to Europe up 15 cts.

text.p: Saudi Arabia raised prices to European customers for its Arab Heavy and extra light Berri crude grades by 15 cents a barrel for September liftings, traders said.
Arab Heavy for September will be priced at Dated Brent -$3.65 a barrel fob Ras Tanura and Berri at Dated Brent -$1.10 fob Tanura from Dated Brent less $3.80 and less $1.25 respectively for August.
Earlier traders said Arab Light for September would be priced at Dated Brent less $1.85 a barrel fob Ras Tanura and Dated Brent less $1.25 fob Sidi Kreir, up 20 cents from August.
Arab Medium was priced at Dated Brent less $2.95 fob Ras Tanura and Dated Brent less $2.35 fob Sidi Kreir, up 25 cents.
